title: Establishment and characterization of bleomycin-induced lung injury in human precision cut lung slices (PCLS)
summary: Im Rahmen dieser Studie soll die Bleomycin-induzierte Lungenschädigung an humanen Precision Cut Lung Slices (PCLS) angewendet, als neues humanes Modell etabliert und charakterisiert werden. Hierfür werden verschiedene Morphologie-, Genom-, Transkriptom- und Proteomanalysen durchgeführt, um neue diagnostische und therapierelevante Targets zu identifizieren.
conditions: Ex vivo induction of lung injury in human PCLS samples.

interventions.name: Benign lung tissue, not relevant for pathological diagnostics, is obtained from patients who undergo lung surgery and have consented to the use of their material for research purposes. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Legal age and capacity to consent
- Presence of the signed Broad Informed Consent (V1.9) from the Thoraxklinik Heidelberg
Exclusion criteria:
- No or insufficient tumor-free biomaterial available that is not required for diagnostics.
